name: vc-value
title: Venture value created per dollar at risk: US venture-backed listings, 2014-2026
description: Stakes held by venture firms and other institutional investors in 424 US venture-backed listings (January 2014 to June 2026, excluding life sciences), the funds that held them, the fund histories of 180 venture firms, and the derived rankings of firms and funds by value created per dollar of capital at risk. All values are measured at a fixed performance end date: the close on 2 October 2026.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR filings (prospectuses, Forms 3, 4 and D, Schedules 13G/13D, Form 13F)
Odin IPO inputs dataset (listing dates, sectors, share counts, offer prices)
Exchange closes on 2 October 2026 (stockanalysis.com, Yahoo Finance)
Fund closes: firm and press announcements, Form D and Form ADV data, public pension reports, public database profiles

resources.name: listings
resources.title: Listings (the universe)
resources.description: One row per US venture-backed, non-life-sciences listing from 24 January 2014 to 12 June 2026 (IPOs, ADR offerings, direct listings and SPAC mergers). Company values are for the shares outstanding at listing, held to the 2 October 2026 close.

resources.name: firms
resources.title: Firms and other holders
resources.description: One row per investment firm or other institutional holder that appears in holdings.csv. Natural persons are not included. measurement_status says whether the firm is ranked on value per dollar, measured but listed separately, or not measured.

resources.name: fund_generations
resources.title: Fund generations
resources.description: One row per fund generation: a main fund with the parallel, principals', entrepreneurs', annex and partners' side vehicles that invest beside it. Single-company vehicles form their own generation. This is the unit of the fund ranking.

resources.name: fund_vehicles
resources.title: Fund vehicles (fund histories)
resources.description: One row per fund vehicle in the fund histories of 180 firms: vintage, committed capital, strategy, scope and capital at risk, with source and confidence. Capital deployed per year by firms without a fund series is recorded as one row per year.

resources.name: holdings
resources.title: Holdings (holder lines)
resources.description: One row per holder line: the stake an institutional holder held going into a listing, as a share of post-offering shares, with its value at the end date, the share bought from the company (primary) and provenance. Holdings of natural persons are not included.

resources.name: fund_allocations
resources.title: Fund allocations
resources.description: How each ranked or measured firm's stake in a listing is split between its fund generations, with the primary fraction of each part and the evidence. Value held by vehicles outside any fund generation carries vehicle_outside_fund_files instead of generation_id.

resources.name: benchmark_prices
resources.title: Public-market benchmark prices
resources.description: Nasdaq-100 year-end closes (before 2017) and QQQ monthly closes (from November 2016) used for the annualised comparison, and the QQQ close on the 2 October 2026 end date.

resources.name: firm_metrics
resources.title: Firm metrics (value per dollar ranking)
resources.description: One row per measured firm: the ranked firms and the firms listed separately. All values at the 2 October 2026 close. Headline: consistency-adjusted value per dollar = (1 + V/K)^(2/3) x (1 + (V - V_top)/K)^(1/3) - 1.

resources.name: firm_robustness
resources.title: Firm ranks under alternative specifications
resources.description: Rank and headline of each ranked firm under the main specification, the 19 alternative specifications and the ex-SpaceX view (see specifications.csv).

resources.name: fund_metrics
resources.title: Fund metrics (fund ranking)
resources.description: One row per fund generation with value: value per dollar and the consistency-adjusted headline at the 2 October 2026 close, with ranges. Ranked: rankable generations of ranked firms.

resources.name: listing_venture_summary
resources.title: Venture ownership and value by listing
resources.description: One row per listing with a holder line: long-term value created, and the stake and primary value of venture funds (firms with counts_as_venture_fund = true). The report's top 20 companies are rank_by_value_end 1 to 20.

resources.name: holding_stage_weights
resources.title: Stage weights by holding (companion ranking)
resources.description: Entry-stage weights and stage-weighted values of each holder line, used only by the companion stage-weighted ranking.

resources.name: stage_weighted_rankings
resources.title: Stage-weighted total-value rankings (companion)
resources.description: Companion ranking of total value created, weighted by the stage of each firm's first round, in three layers.

resources.name: timing_weights
resources.title: Timing weights for capital at risk
resources.description: Share of a fund's eventual listings expected to fall inside the 2014-2026 window, by vintage and strategy (main specification), and the weight for capital deployed in a given calendar year.

resources.name: lag_distributions
resources.title: Entry-to-listing lag distributions
resources.description: Probability that a listing occurs a given number of years after the firm's entry, by entry-stage group, estimated from 554 entry-to-listing pairs corrected for double truncation (Efron-Petrosian) and smoothed.

resources.name: strategy_parameters
resources.title: Deployment and stage-mix parameters
resources.description: Deployment schedule (share of commitments invested in each year from vintage) and entry-stage mix by fund strategy, used to compute timing weights.

resources.name: specifications
resources.title: Robustness specifications
resources.description: The main specification, the 19 alternative specifications and the ex-SpaceX view used in firm_robustness.csv.

resources.name: coverage_register
resources.title: Coverage-check register
resources.description: Every (firm, listing) pair the version 7 coverage check found missing from the holder tables, with sources, 13F counts and the outcome.
